name: Reality shop – Unlimited 3D for Elementor and WooCommerce
author: kouroshweb

sections.description:
🔥 Reality Shop 3D – WooCommerce 3D & 360° Product Viewer for WordPress
Reality Shop 3D is a powerful and lightweight 3D Product Viewer for WordPress and WooCommerce that lets you display interactive 3D models (GLB) and 360° product views without coding.
Easily add a WooCommerce 3D viewer, 360° product rotation, or interactive 3D model to any page using Elementor, Gutenberg, or shortcode.
Boost conversions, increase engagement, and give your customers a real product experience.

🚀 Why Choose Reality Shop 3D?
Unlike heavy 3D plugins, Reality Shop 3D is built for:
✔ Speed & performance
✔ Seamless WooCommerce integration
✔ Native Elementor & Gutenberg support
✔ Clean and lightweight code
✔ Easy setup – no coding required
✔ Display models in pop-up or modal
✔ Free and Unlimited 3D
✔ Product 3D viewer by PNGs
Perfect for online stores, product showcases, portfolios, and interactive landing pages.

✨ Key Features

🎯 3D Model Viewer for WordPress
•Upload and manage GLB 3D models
•Interactive zoom and rotation
•Auto-rotate option
•Fullscreen mode
•Lazy loading for performance optimization

🛍 WooCommerce 3D Product Viewer
•Add 3D models directly to product pages
•Improve product visualization
•Increase customer trust and reduce returns

🔄 360° Product Viewer
•Create smooth 360° product rotation
•Supports PNG image sequences
•Ideal for fashion, electronics, accessories, furniture

🎨 Elementor 3D Widget
•Drag & drop 3D viewer widget
•Fully customizable
•Works with Elementor Free & Pro

🧱 Gutenberg Block Support
•Native block for easy embedding
•Works inside posts and pages

⚡ Performance Optimized
•Lightweight structure
•Compatible with cache plugins
•Clean uninstall (removes all data safely)

🌍 Premium Features (Optional)
• AR (Augmented Reality) Support
• Try-On Experience
• Advanced interaction controls

📈 Who Is It For?
Reality Shop 3D is perfect for:
• WooCommerce stores
• Fashion & accessories brands
• Furniture & interior shops
• Electronics stores
• 3D artists & designers
• Product landing pages
• Digital showrooms

🧩 Supported Formats
• GLB (3D models)
• 360° PNG sequences

💡 Why 3D & 360° Products Increase Sales?
Interactive 3D product visualization:
• Improves user engagement
• Increases time on page
• Builds purchase confidence
• Reduces product return rates
• Enhances mobile shopping experience
Reality Shop 3D gives your store a modern, immersive product experience.

🔧 Requirements
+ WordPress 5.5+ (tested up to the latest releases)
+ PHP 7.4+
+ Fully compatible with Elementor, Gutenberg, and WooCommerce out of the box.
+ Most popular themes and Pluginsincluding performance/speed such as wp rocket, litespeed cache, wp-optimize, …. .

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Upload it to your WordPress site via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to Reality Shop 3D in the WordPress admin menu to manage your GLB files.
  5. Use items or Elementor widgets to display 3D models.
sections.faq:
How 36o View by PNGs work?

Upload as many as PNG photos you can, and show a 360 Product View by Woocoommerce, Elementor by using RealityShop 3D plugin.

How do I upload a GLB file?

Go to Reality Shop 3D in your WordPress dashboard, click “Upload File,” and select your GLB model.

How do I add 3D models into WooCommerce product?

In the product edit page, find the Reality Shop 3D Shortcode metabox and paste the generated item.

How many woocommerce products can I insert 3D modules?

You are able to diplay unlimited 3D modules in your woocommerce products

What amount of modules can I display?

There are no limit for your 3D modules to display in your website

What happens when I delete a GLB file?

If a GLB file is deleted from the plugin’s admin panel, all associated product items will be removed.

Is this plugin Elementor compatible?

Yes! You can use the 3D GLB Viewer widget in Elementor to display models.

what themes/plugins are compatible?

Almost all theme and products are well compatible with our plugin otherwise please contact us for support
